summary: Extra tools for development and CI, installed with `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`. It pulls in the runtime requirements first, so one command sets up everything needed to lint, test and build the walkthrough. The Docker image deliberately installs only `requirements.txt`.

notes.text: `-r` includes another requirements file, so the runtime dependencies are installed too without repeating the list.
pytest, the test runner configured in `pyproject.toml`.
Ruff, the linter that CI runs with `ruff check .`.
Pygments, the syntax highlighter used only by `scripts/build_walkthrough.py`, as the trailing comment notes (pip allows `#` comments after a requirement).
